sources.title: Introducing span-detect-1
sources.snippet: Our code detector is powered by span-detect-1, a state-of-the-art machine learning model for chunk-level detection of AI generated code. span-detect-1 ties AI coding assistants to code shipped into production for the first time, creating clearer visibility into impact and ROI.

sources.title: Span - AI-native engineering intelligence and automations
sources.snippet: Span is a developer intelligence platform that uniquely links agent traces to code and PRs, connecting real activity to downstream outcomes. Complete, prompt-to-prod view helps teams understand what drives AI-coding effectiveness and where to improve.
